title: Surreal Butterfly Oracle
description: A three-faced figure with large green and purple butterfly wings stands on a stone bridge over dark water, holding a glowing purple orb containing a small silhouette. The scene is set within ancient stone ruins with multiple melting clocks, against a black sky featuring a red ringed planet and purple nebula.
prompt: A surreal three-faced figure wearing a black robe with clock patterns stands centered on a stone bridge over dark water within ancient ruins. The figure has large translucent green and purple butterfly wings with clock designs, holds a glowing purple orb with a tiny human silhouette inside. Multiple melting clocks are placed on pillars and floating. Black sky background with a large red planet with rings and purple nebula. Dreamlike and mysterious atmosphere.
